announcement.label: FESTIVAL UPDATE
announcement.message: The official 2026 festival guide is live. Download your essentials before you arrive.

guide.title: Pack smart
guide.text: Bring sunscreen, a refillable water bottle, a rain layer, and warm layers for after sunset. Mountain weather can shift quickly.

guide.title: Hydrate early
guide.text: Telluride sits at 8,750 feet. The official guide recommends hydrating, pacing alcohol, and preparing for the altitude.

guide.title: Festival essentials
guide.text: Download or screenshot your pass before arriving. Bring an empty reusable bottle and review the official allowed-items list.

guide.title: Getting around
guide.text: The gondola between Telluride and Mountain Village is free. Walking, biking, and public transit are the easiest options.

faq.question: When are the festival gates open?
faq.answer: Town Park festival gates are open daily from 11:30 AM to 9:30 PM. Juke Joint after-hours shows begin at 10:00 PM at venues around town.

faq.question: How do I get my 2026 wristband?
faq.answer: Wristbands are not mailed. About one week before the festival, ticket buyers receive a digital Front Gate ticket by email. Each attendee must bring their own digital or printed ticket and valid photo ID to the Festival Box Office at 300 E Pacific Street.

faq.question: What are the box office hours?
faq.answer: Thursday 10:00 AM–6:30 PM; Friday and Saturday 9:00 AM–8:15 PM; Sunday 10:00 AM–7:15 PM. Early pickup is encouraged.

faq.question: What can I bring inside?
faq.answer: Allowed items include a valid photo ID, reusable bottle, sunscreen and hat, backpack or wagon, low-back lawn chair, one tarp or blanket no larger than 5×8 feet, cooler with sealed water, soda and food, snacks, warm and rain layers, phone or point-and-shoot camera, and a stroller. Bags and coolers are subject to search.

faq.question: What must stay home?
faq.answer: No glass, pets, outside alcohol, illegal drugs, unlicensed vending, professional camera or video gear, frisbees, shelled nuts, or weapons are permitted.

faq.question: What accessibility support is available?
faq.answer: The festival is wheelchair accessible, with a viewing space in front of the sound booth, accessible restrooms and porta-potties, and limited accessible parking in the Town Park lot via the vehicle bridge at the park entrance.

faq.question: Where should I park?
faq.answer: There is no dedicated festival parking lot. Use legal parking in Telluride. Main Street and nearby side streets are metered from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM Monday–Saturday; Sunday is excluded. Residential O, G and W permit rules do not apply during festival weekend.

faq.question: How do I get around without a car?
faq.answer: The Telluride–Mountain Village gondola is free and runs 7:00 AM–midnight during the festival. The free Galloping Goose loops town every 20 minutes. Mountain Village also offers free daily shuttles and Dial-A-Ride at 970-728-8888.

faq.question: What weather should I expect?
faq.answer: The official guide lists average mid-September temperatures of 65°F high and 40°F low, with sunset around 7:15 PM. Sunshine, rain, and even snow are possible in one day; the festival is rain or shine.

faq.question: What food and facilities are on site?
faq.answer: The grounds provide free drinking water, restrooms and hand sinks, trash/recycling/compost stations, food and craft vendors, drinks for purchase, a kids area, medical tent, and lost and found. Official food information notes vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free choices.

faq.question: Are children free?
faq.answer: Children age 11 and under are admitted free when accompanied by an adult.

faq.question: Can I bring my pet?
faq.answer: No. Town Park rules prohibit pets on the festival grounds and in the campground. The official FAQ also says not to leave pets in vehicles or tied to vehicles.
